applicableAreas: All five transformer pads (Electrical Plan Sheet 21, Pads 1-5)
findings.comment: Transformer pad locations are shown on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21), but no horizontal clearance dimensions are provided between any transformer pad and adjacent buildings or structures. Minimum 5-foot clearance from buildings cannot be verified without explicit measurements on plans.

applicableAreas: Potential transformer pad locations near retaining walls on site perimeter
findings.comment: Retaining walls are present along the north, east, and south perimeters of the site (shown on Site Plan Sheet 9 and Wall Plan Sheets 38-39). However, no clearance dimensions are shown between transformer pads and retaining walls. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pads (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Transformer access door orientation is not indicated on plans - no markings, arrows, or clear workspace designations shown. No clearance dimensions are provided between transformer pads and site fences. Required clearances (5 feet for sides with operators/controls, 3 feet for sides without) cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pads (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are shown between transformer pads and buildings. If any clearances less than 5 feet are proposed, the required Austin Energy Design written approval and compliance documentation (fire rating certification, vertical clearance confirmation, confined space analysis) is not provided on plans.

applicableAreas: Potential transformer pad locations relative to building elevations
findings.comment: Building elevations are not provided in the submitted site plan. No clearance dimensions are shown between transformer pads and building overhangs or balconies. No vertical clearance analysis is provided showing that no structures directly overhang transformer pads.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads relative to adjacent buildings (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: No transformer equipment specifications are provided indicating whether equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. No window, door, or ventilating duct locations on adjacent buildings are shown relative to transformer pads. No clearance dimensions (12-foot horizontal minimum) are documented. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads adjacent to sidewalks (Pads 1-3 per Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Sidewalk locations are shown on Site Plan (Sheet 9) and Landscape Plan (Sheet 31). However, no clearance dimensions are provided between transformer pads and sidewalk back-of-curb locations. Minimum 2-foot clearance cannot be verified from available dimensions.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads relative to fire exits and stairs (Sheet 21, Sheet 10)
findings.comment: No fire escape or external stair locations are shown on the Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) or site plan. No transformer equipment specifications indicate whether equipment is oil-filled (which triggers the 20-foot fire escape clearance requirement). The 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance from fire escapes cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pads (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Transformer access door orientation is not indicated on Electrical Plan. No hot-stick use area workspace is designated or dimensioned. Minimum 10-foot clearance from access door to open area or adjacent structures cannot be verified without access door orientation and clearance dimensions.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pads if located in confined spaces (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided analyzing whether transformer locations face confined spaces (niche, vault, or enclosed area on 3+ sides). No 15-foot clearance documentation is provided for any confined space scenarios. Compliance with 15-foot confined space clearance requirement cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to fire hydrant near Buildings 6-7 (Sheet 10, Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows one proposed fire hydrant located near Building 7. Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer Pad 5 in the vicinity. No clearance dimension is provided between the fire hydrant and transformer pad locations. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Landscape plantings in proximity to transformer pads and overhead electric lines (Sheet 21, Sheet 31)
findings.comment: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) shows trees and vegetation layout but provides only generic symbols (SY, PL, P, M) without specific tree species names. No reference to ECM Appendix F utility-compatible species list is provided. Trees within 10 lateral feet of transformer pads or within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution cannot be verified as utility-compatible.

applicableAreas: Shrubs and low vegetation adjacent to transformer pads (Sheet 21, Sheet 31)
findings.comment: Landscape Plan shows vegetation symbols but transformer access door orientation is not indicated. No clearance dimensions are provided between shrub plantings and transformer access door side (10 lateral feet required) or other sides (5 lateral feet required). Vegetation clearances cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of transformer pad locations and underground electric equipment (Sheet 21, Sheet 31)
findings.comment: Landscape Plan shows tree locations but no root barrier details are shown or specified. No dimensions are provided showing which trees fall within 20 lateral feet of transformer pads or underground electric equipment. Required root barrier specifications (minimum 4 feet deep, 5 feet from equipment) cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to trash/dumpster enclosures (Sheet 21, Sheet 9)
findings.comment: Site Plan (Sheet 9) indicates trash collection is curbside with no centralized dumpster enclosure shown. However, specific locations where trash bins will be stored are not documented. Clearance from transformer pads cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Bike rack locations relative to transformer pads (Sheet 21, Sheet 22)
findings.comment: Construction Details Sheet 22 contains bicycle rack specifications but does not show specific bike rack locations relative to transformer pads. No clearance dimensions are provided. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Light pole locations relative to transformer pads (Sheet 9, Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Site Plan notes indicate lighting will be located on buildings per Subchapter E 2.5, but specific light pole locations are not shown on the site plan. Transformer Pad locations are shown on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21). Minimum 5-foot clearance between light poles and transformer pads cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Fire lane routing and transformer pad locations (Sheet 10, Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) designates fire lanes with 26-foot width marked and red curb stenciling required at 30-foot intervals. Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pads adjacent to fire lanes. However, no clearance dimension is provided between transformer pads and the fire lane edge. Minimum 15-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Multiple transformer pads (Pads 1-5 on Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Five transformer pads are shown on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21). No clearance dimensions are provided between any pairs of transformer pads. Minimum 5-foot clearance between transformer pads cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads relative to water service lines (Sheet 21, Sheet 19)
findings.comment: Water service lines are shown on Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) and Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer locations. However, no clearance dimensions are provided between transformer pads and water service lines. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads relative to wastewater service lines (Sheet 21, Sheet 19)
findings.comment: Wastewater service lines are shown on Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) and Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer locations. However, no clearance dimensions are provided between transformer pads and wastewater service lines. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads relative to storm drain lines (Sheet 21, Sheet 12)
findings.comment: Storm drain infrastructure is shown on Storm Sewer Plan (Sheet 12) and Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer locations. However, no clearance dimensions are provided between transformer pads and storm drain lines. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads relative to gas service (Sheet 21, Sheet 19)
findings.comment: Utility plans do not indicate whether gas service is provided to the site. If gas service exists, no clearance dimensions (24 inches for gas <60 psi, 36 inches for gas ≥60 psi) are provided between transformer pads and gas lines. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads relative to underground utilities (Sheet 21, Sheet 19, Sheet 12)
findings.comment: Underground utility lines are shown on various utility plans, but no horizontal or vertical clearance dimensions are provided between transformer pads and other utilities. Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to other utilities and structures (Sheet 21, Sheet 19)
findings.comment: Transformer locations and utility line routing are shown on plans but no cross-reference analysis or conflict check documentation is provided verifying that transformer pads are not located over or under other utility lines, and that no customer structures are installed over AE underground facilities.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to overhead electric lines (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines are shown on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21), and transformer pads are located near these lines. However, no horizontal sky-to-ground clearance dimensions are provided. Minimum 7.5-foot horizontal clearance from ground to sky above transformer locations cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to overhead distribution conductors (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Overhead distribution conductors (primary and neutral) are shown on Electrical Plan but specific conductor locations relative to transformer pads are not dimensioned. No 15-foot radius clearance verification is provided. Compliance cannot be verified from available documentation.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations if in niche configuration (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided analyzing whether any transformer is located in a niche (accessible from outside but within building footprint). No 35-foot vertical clearance documentation is provided for any niche scenarios. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads if in niche service configuration (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: No niche service configurations are evident from available plans. If niche service were proposed, the required architectural specifications (3-hour fire wall rating, ventilation specifications) and Austin Energy Design coordination documentation are not provided.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.3 (survey requirement as required by AE Design)
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations with overhead structures, parking areas, or enclosed access paths (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances for transformer access paths, overhead structures, parking areas, or enclosed areas. Cross-sections required to demonstrate compliance with vertical clearance requirements are missing from the site plan.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads if oil-filled equipment is proposed (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: No transformer equipment specifications indicate whether equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. Grading Plan (Sheet 11) shows general site drainage flowing away from buildings, but specific surface flow direction around individual transformer pads is not documented. Drainage compliance for oil-filled equipment cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pads (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Plat (Sheet 2) and Site Plan (Sheet 9) show property boundaries but no explicit documentation confirms that all transformer pads are located 100% on private property and do not straddle property lines. Status cannot be verified without detailed boundary analysis.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 4 (property requirement); easement-specific regulations
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to drainage, water, sewer, and overhead easements (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Plat (Sheet 2) shows various easements (drainage, water, sewer, electric, public utility). Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer locations but does not clearly coordinate pad placement relative to prohibited easements. No Austin Energy Design written approval is provided if pads are located within easements. Compliance status cannot be verified.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.3 (additional clearance and access easements may be required)
applicableAreas: All five transformer pads (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: No transformer easements are shown on the Plat (Sheet 2) or Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) surrounding the transformer pads. No easement widths or accessibility requirements are documented. Transformer easement requirements cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Electrical routing from all transformer pads to meters (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer locations and general electrical routing but does not explicitly confirm that the entire electrical path from transformer to meter is 100% on private property. Routing details are insufficient to verify full private property compliance.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.18.0 (obtain transformer pad detail from AE Design)
applicableAreas: All five transformer pads (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are referenced or attached to the site plan. Pad dimensions are not specified, and no transformer specifications (kVA, service type: single-phase or three-phase) are documented on the Electrical Plan. Compliance cannot be verified without AE Design-approved details.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pads adjacent to parking areas and vehicle circulation (Pads 1-5 on Sheet 21)
findings.comment: All five transformer pads shown on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) are located within 4 feet of parking areas, drive aisles, or vehicle circulation routes. No 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal bollard specifications, spacing details, or placement drawings are provided. Required bollards are not documented.

applicableAreas: Customer facilities relative to overhead distribution facilities (Sheet 21, Sheet 9)
findings.comment: Overhead distribution facilities are shown on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21). However, no cross-reference coordination is provided verifying that no customer facilities (buildings, parking garages, light poles, signs) are installed under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution lines.
